title: micromelum compressum var. inodorum
intro: Micromelum compressum var. inodorum, commonly known as the fragrant screwtree or Indian screw tree, is a plant species that belongs to the Rutaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Micromelum compressum var. inodorum include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which aid in relieving respiratory congestion and promoting overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, limonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
